-1.title: File:St John in the Wilderness Church, Sukhatal, Mallital, Nainital, Uttarakhand, India.jpg

ObjectName.value: St John in the Wilderness Church, Sukhatal, Mallital, Nainital, Uttarakhand, India

Categories.value: Self-published work|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|St. John in the Wilderness Church (Nainital)

ImageDescription.value:
St. John in the Wilderness Church is situated near Sukhatal, Mallital, Nainital, Uttarakhand, India. It's one of the oldest buildings in Nainital since 1848. A memorial in the church is to those killed in the 1880 landslip.
The cemetery in the church has graves from 1845 to around 1922 with the last burial being of Sir George Knox. The graves include those of the mother and father of Jim Corbett.

Artist.value: Photographer Praveen Singh Bisht
